description:
Hushfeed v0.65.0 has 98 patches for global TikTok 47.0.3 and 47.1.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

Mute feed videos now works on TikTok 47.1.3 and silences photo posts on 47.0.3, and it stays quiet after you watch the same video from a DM or scroll a long profile grid. Press and hold the Home tab to open Hushfeed's settings. Every save says it's been taken the moment you ask, and saves connect only to the server address Hushfeed checked.

Hushfeed's buttons over the video now show on videos opened from a profile, a hashtag or a sound. The time budget's hold comes the moment it runs out, Forget saved videos clears the already-saved record, and the block button and sticker Save no longer close TikTok on Android 10 and older. See the changelog for the full list.

Validation: 2490 runtime tests passed and 459 patch tests passed locally. Both Android lint checks passed. All 98 patches applied to both supported APKs with resource and manifest checks. The attached release receipt identifies the exact source and bundle. The mute, the checked-address saves and the Home long press were checked on phones and Android emulators running TikTok 47.0.3 and 47.1.3.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer. Refresh the Hushfeed source to update. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
